descriptionPlain:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!


Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

As Director of Brand and Creative, you'll own Proof's brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, and creative output across every touchpoint, including proof.com, campaigns, events, sales materials, and executive presence. Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

lists.text: What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:
lists.content:
• Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.
  • Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.
  • Brand hub and templates: Build a self-serve brand hub and template library so Sales,
    Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.
  • Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for
    campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.
  • Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.
  • Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.
  • Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research
    (awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

• 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.
  • A portfolio showing brand systems and campaigns that made complex or trust-centric products clear and distinctive.
  • Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion. 
  • Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.
  • Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

lists.text: You'll really stand out if you have:
lists.content:
• Experience building brands for financial services, payments, or identity companies.
  • Experience with AI-assisted creative workflows and modern tooling (Figma, Adobe CC, Webflow).
  • Experience spanning both B2B enterprise and consumer-facing touchpoints.

Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

• Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
  • Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

lists.text: What you’ll do as the Director of Product Marketing at Proof:
lists.content:
• Positioning and messaging: Own product and solution positioning and the messaging architecture (value propositions, proof points, and differentiation) across the VDC, identity verification, eSign/eNotary, and agentic authorization, tailored by segment (banking, mortgage, insurance, wealth) and buyer persona.
  • Launches and go-to-market: Run the launch process for new products and major features, from tiering and readiness through announcement, enablement, an post-launch measurement. Shape use-case plays such as account opening, high-value money movement, title and closing, and agent-initiated transactions with Revenue Marketing and Sales.
  • Sales enablement: Build and maintain the core sales toolkit, including pitch decks, solution briefs, discovery guides, business-case and ROI tools, objection handling, and demo narratives. Run ongoing enablement for Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partners.
  • Market and competitive insight: Lead win/loss analysis, customer interviews, persona and buying-committee research, and competitive intelligence across identity verification, digital credentials, eSignature, and fraud prevention vendors, including maintained battlecards.
  • Product partnership: Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap priorities. Track regulatory developments (CIP/KYC, digital identity, and eNotary legislation) and translate them into market opportunities and messaging.
  • Cross-functional content: Supply product and roadmap content for analyst briefings (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, Liminal, Celent, Datos Insights) with the Director of Communications, and product inputs for demand programs, content, and events.
  • Team leadership: Manage and develop the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager and grow the product marketing team over time, so that product, partner, and customer messaging stay aligned.

• 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience at a SaaS, fintech, identity, security, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years leading product marketing teams and launches end to end
  • Experience marketing technical or API-driven products to regulated enterprise buyers, ideally financial institutions.
  • A record of creating positioning for a new or emerging category, with launches that measurably improved pipeline and win rates.
  • Enough technical fluency to understand PKI, cryptographic credentials, identity verification, and fraud concepts, and to explain them simply and accurately.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage executives, customers, and analysts.

lists.text: You’ll really stand out if you have:
lists.content:

  • Experience marketing AI or agentic products and the trust and authorization questions they raise.

As Senior Manager of Marketing Operations, you'll own the marketing technology stack, lead lifecycle, attribution, and reporting that make the whole team faster and more accountable. Day to day, you'll work closely with Revenue Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Finance to keep data clean, programs running, and leadership confident in marketing's impact.

additionalPlain:
This position will be posted and accepting applications through November 13, 2026.
 
Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.


Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

descriptionPlain:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!


We are looking for an experienced Strategic Enterprise Account Executive to join our Sales team to manage the most critical prospect and customer accounts. In this hunter role, you will be responsible for building and executing the strategy to develop cold accounts into customers, while also working closely with Customer Success to grow current customer accounts. Enjoys being part of a small fast paced start up environment and is a self starter. Experience in selling digital transformational SaaS solutions to verticals in FinTech, Banking, Insurance, Mortgage/Title. Prior knowledge of product solutions selling security, identity verification or eSign is a plus. Thrives in creative problem solving with a challenger sales mentality. This position requires regular travel to attend trade shows, meet customers, and build relationships. This is a high-profile individual contributor role with commensurate compensation. Remote working environment.

lists.text: As our Strategic Account Executive, you will:
lists.content:
• Orchestrate and close profitable growth contracts that exceed $1M in committed annual revenue selling as a team.
  • Establish executive relationships within prospect, customer, and partner accounts. 
  • Become a subject matter expert in digital identity, fraud prevention, and trusted online transactions.
  • Develop and execute custom account plans for each assigned account.
  • Independently own a successful outbound pipeline generation strategy.
  • Professionally manage daily deal progression activities with a sense of urgency.
  • Lead the review and negotiation of contractual agreements in partnership with Legal. 
  • Perform business reporting and forecasting duties within Salesforce and company systems
  • Communicate effectively in writing leveraging Slack, Google Suite, and email. 
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams outside of GTM to improve our company and take advantage of market opportunities.

lists.text: As our Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you should have:
lists.content:
• Demonstrable track record closing $1M/year new logo SaaS contracts with Fortune 1000 accounts.
  • Experience in identity verification, digital identity, or identity infrastructure, with exposure to areas such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), fraud and risk, AML/KYC, or trust and safety solutions highly preferred.
  • The desire for feedback and coaching.
  • Existing relationships within key accounts. 
  • Tremendous business acumen and judgment.
  • Strong analytical skills with an attention to detail.
  • Executive presence.
  • Technical proficiency with modern enterprise software productivity tools.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a problem-solving orientation.
Travel: This role requires approximately 50% travel, including regular customer visits, team meetings, and industry events.

• Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
  • Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

lists.text: Here are some of our great benefits:
lists.content:
• Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
  • 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
  • Unlimited Sick and Vacation time
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
  • Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
  • Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit
  • Monthly work from home stipend
  • Professional development credit
  • Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
  • And more!

salaryDescription: This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, commissions, the benefits listed above, and equity.
